description.en:
Rongzai-Your neutron scattering data analysis assistant
by CSNS data analysis group
description.zh:
蓉仔——你的中子散射数据分析助手
by 中国散裂中子源数据分析组

examples.en: The datasets/testData directory contains neutron diffraction and neutron PDF data for two high-entropy alloy materials with chemical formulas AgMnPbSbTe4 and AgMnGePbSbTe5. AgMnGePbSbTe5 is obtained by Ge doping of AgMnPbSbTe4. I have also built tentative CIF structures for both materials and attached them as a starting point for your analysis. Use these data to carefully and thoroughly study the structural characteristics of these two materials and the effects of Ge doping. Perform a thorough analysis of the data without worrying about the analysis time.
examples.zh: datasets/testData中是两个材料的中子衍射和中子PDF数据。这两个材料分别是化学式为AgMnPbSbTe4和AgMnGePbSbTe5的高熵合金材料。AgMnGePbSbTe5是在AgMnPbSbTe4基础上进行Ge掺杂得到的。此外，我还构建了两种材料的推测cif结构，一并附给你作为分析的起点。你用这些数据仔细深入研究这两个材料的结构特征，以及Ge掺杂带来的影响。要求对数据进行彻底分析，不用考虑分析时长。

examples.en: Example1: Help me refine the BL16 RUN0023568 group5 diffraction spectrum using GSAS-II, the cif file is Si.cif
examples.zh: 示例1：用GSAS-II帮我把BL16的RUN0023568的group5的衍射谱精修好，cif文件是Si.cif

examples.en: Example2: Help me fit the PDF data of BL16 RUN0023568, the fitting range is 1-15 Å, the cif file is Si.cif
examples.zh: 示例2：帮我拟合好BL16的RUN0023568的PDF数据，拟合范围在1-15埃，cif文件是Si.cif
